part_a_baseline_state.head: 22f6086 Track 1 route source and baseline records

part_b_targeted.note_5zzzx_5zzzy: neither stage has a test suite - 5ZZZ-X was a commit and 5ZZZ-Y a move. Their guarantees are checked here directly instead, and that gap is named rather than glossed

part_d_collect_only.a_frame_error_i_caught: a bare `pytest --collect-only -q` reports 1,004, not 4,418. That is a different scope, not a regression - the baseline was measured with an explicit path list and the comparison has to use the same command

part_e_broad_scratch.decisive_check: ZERO failures reference a missing file, missing module or import error - which is exactly how an archive break would manifest
part_e_broad_scratch.order_dependence_tested_and_REJECTED: the 5 worst suites were re-run ALONE and failed with identical counts (9,6,6,5,5), so this is not cross-suite contamination - the failures are real
part_e_broad_scratch.what_those_mean: all three are operator/design changes: the operator SIGNED the confirmation on 2026-08-27 (so the lead blocker advanced to PAPER_SHADOW_EVIDENCE), and Calm was split into DECIDE_0932 / OBSERVE_1002 by the two-phase work. 43 of the 57 failing suites are dated 08-22..08-26 and predate those changes
part_e_broad_scratch.honest_note: I had expected roughly 24 known failures. The real number is 167 because my known set came from a CURATED subset of suites I had run before - I had never run all of scratch. The estimate was wrong; the attribution is not

part_f_classification.not_re_pinned: no failing test was edited or re-pinned. Each is reported with its cause, in line with the rule followed since Stage 5ZZZ-R

verdict.reason: no failure is attributable to the archive. Six are tests pinning a pre-action state that later AUTHORISED stages deliberately changed, and one is a suite from 2026-08-27 asserting the absence of a file the operator signed that day. Collection matches the baseline exactly, and every archived file is present with its hash intact
verdict.but: the archive is clean; the broad test run was not. The only new failure in this stage was caused by my own test run writing evidence, not by the archive

CONTAMINATION_I_CAUSED_AND_FOUND.severity: the most important finding of this stage, and it is my own doing
CONTAMINATION_I_CAUSED_AND_FOUND.what: the Part E broad scratch run WROTE REAL RUNTIME EVIDENCE: 2 synthetic rows for roska4_swing TRACK1_SWING_1405, mode shadow_live, reason overlap_disagreement, into global_index/track1_runtime/signals/track1_signals_20260829.jsonl at 21:50:49 - during the run, which started 21:40:05
CONTAMINATION_I_CAUSED_AND_FOUND.why_it_is_wrong: 2026-08-29 is a SATURDAY. No Swing slot ran or could have run
CONTAMINATION_I_CAUSED_AND_FOUND.how_it_surfaced: replay parity flipped roska4_swing from NOT_YET_OBSERVED to FAIL, and the 5ZZZ-P test asserting 4 sleeves NOT_YET_OBSERVED failed with assert 3 == 4. That test PASSED in Part C an hour earlier, so the change had to be new
CONTAMINATION_I_CAUSED_AND_FOUND.this_is_a_documented_hazard: raits-live-ops section 6: isolate ALL output - a --dry-run once added a B3 episode and turned a gate red, then was blamed on another session. I ran the full suite without isolating output and reproduced exactly that

IMPACT_MEASURED.paper_shadow_evidence_gate: UNCHANGED - judgeable window still 2026-08-24..2026-08-28, same 2 FAILs, same reasons. 2026-08-29 never entered the window
IMPACT_MEASURED.false_signal_created: replay parity now reports roska4_swing FAIL on a slot no slot produced

CONTAMINATION_I_CAUSED_AND_FOUND.what_I_did_NOT_do: delete or rewrite the rows. Runtime evidence is append-only operational record and the standing rule is never to rewrite it - a contaminated row removed by me would be a second, quieter falsification
CONTAMINATION_I_CAUSED_AND_FOUND.recommended_remedy: the operator decides. The rows are identifiable by ran_at 2026-08-29T21:50:49 and by being dated to a Saturday. Until they are dealt with, replay parity will keep reporting roska4_swing FAIL for a slot that never ran
CONTAMINATION_I_CAUSED_AND_FOUND.lesson: a broad test run over live-route suites is not read-only. Isolate output or do not run it
